_why: Today's .claude/settings.json is plants-frontend's copy. It runs three Sonar hook scripts (.claude/hooks/sonar-secrets/build-scripts/pretool-secrets.sh, prompt-secrets.sh and .claude/sonar-analyze.sh) that overrides.json lists under `deleted`, so none exists and Claude Code reports a missing hook script on every prompt, read and stop. It also means guard-edit.js (the edit guard beside this file) never runs. This proposal replaces the file with designer settings: no Sonar hooks, the edit guard, and an allowlist for the designer commands so designers are not asked to approve every step. It also adds .claude/settings.json to overrides.json `ours`, so the weekly sync stops bringing plants-frontend's copy back.
_how_to_apply: 1. On a maintain/<slug> branch, replace .claude/settings.json with proposed_settings_json below.
2. In the same commit, add ".claude/settings.json" to the `ours` list in overrides.json (proposed_overrides_json_change).
3. Run npm test: scripts/sync-upstream/overrides.test.js and scripts/designer/suite.test.js must still pass.

4. Delete the missing-hook notes from CLAUDE.md ("Read more") and PROTOTYPE.md ("Working with Claude Code"), the settings bullet under "For maintainers" in README.md, the "once the prototype's settings are in place" aside in PROTOTYPE.md ("Using Cursor or another assistant"), and the pointer to this file at the top of scripts/designer/hooks/guard-edit.js. Then delete this file.

_allowlist_notes.Bash(git status:*): design-session and share-my-change run `git status --porcelain` and `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall -- <paths>`; a bare `git status` rule does not match those.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(git branch --show-current): design-session, share-my-change and the research switch read the current branch this way.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(git stash push:*): share-my-change and design-session put away new, unsaved files with `git stash push --include-untracked` instead of deleting them, so they can come back.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(git stash pop:*): share-my-change's undo of unsaved edits puts the whole change aside, and 'bring back what you put aside' pops it.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(git fetch upstream main): hand-off fetches plants-frontend's main (read only; the upstream push address is DISABLED) so the brief can say whether the patch still applies to plants-frontend itself.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(git remote ...): a fresh clone has no `upstream` remote. run-the-prototype and hand-off add it (fetch only) and lock its push address, exactly as designer:preflight prints. Changing upstream's fetch address is denied.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(npx --yes npm@11.6.2 ci): must match package.json `packageManager`; scripts/designer/suite.test.js fails when the weekly sync bumps one without the other.
_allowlist_notes.Bash(gh pr merge:*): share-my-change merges only when the designer asks and has merge rights; a prompt every time is right.

_notes: The guard hook fails open (exit 0) on bad input or when git fails, allows everything on handoff/* and maintain/* branches, warns on `patched` files, and blocks real-service, removed and frozen-release files with exit 2 and a plain message.
`npm run -s designer:*` does not match `Bash(npm run designer:*)`. The skills call `npm run designer:*` and read JSON after npm's banner lines.
Workflow agents inherit these permissions. Without them an unattended design-session stalls on every prompt.
